note: Which curves are one simulation suite's fiducial run and which are variants of it, and what kind of variant (numerical, parametric, cosmology, component, ablation). Used by scripts/analyze_model_form.py (protocol docs/PROTOCOL-model-form.md). A variant differs from its base run by one documented change unless the change field says otherwise; the classes are the author's reading of the cited tables and are fixed before any analysis.

classes.numerical: same model, different resolution or volume; where the authors recalibrate the subgrid parameters to the same data at each resolution ('weak convergence') this is stated in the change field
classes.parametric: the same model with the numerical value of one or two subgrid parameters changed (the model's own parameter freedom)
classes.calibration: the same model recalibrated to a shifted calibration target (the authors' emulator-based recalibration of several parameters at once)
classes.cosmology: the same galaxy formation model in a different cosmology or dark matter model
classes.component: a feature of the model switched back to its older form or off (a change of functional form, not of a parameter value)
classes.implementation: a different implementation of one process (for example thermal versus jet AGN feedback)

IllustrisTNG.evidence: TNG model on the 25 Mpc/h box L25n512 (Pillepich+18, arXiv:1703.02970); the TNG100 and TNG300 curves of the TNG papers are not in the dataset

FLAMINGO.evidence: L1_m9 (Schaye+23, arXiv:2306.04024), the website's fiducial run

COLIBRE.evidence: m6 (L200) (Schaye+26, arXiv:2508.21126), the intermediate resolution of the flagship

FIREbox.evidence: FB1024, all identified galaxies (Feldmann+23, arXiv:2205.15325); the 'massive' curve counts only galaxies above 10^9.3 Msun and is not a total

SIMBA.evidence: m100n1024 (Dave+19, arXiv:1901.10203); the density frame is not stated (see the protocol, validation V3)

Horizon-AGN.evidence: Kaviraj+17; the density frame, cosmology and SFR indicator are not stated

excludedFamilies.FLARES: galaxies with SFR >= 0.1 Msun/yr only (not a total) and a weighted combination of 40 zoom regions
excludedFamilies.THESAN-zoom: galaxies brighter than M_UV = -17 of 14 zoom regions, dust attenuated (not a total)
excludedFamilies.NewHorizon: a small zoom region that is not volume-complete, density frame not stated
